The '''''Starhunter Dhelba''''' was a [[Starhunter menagerie ark]] that operated during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[800 BBY/Legends|800 BBY]], it crashed on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It had been carrying various creatures, including [[Teek/Legends|teeks]], [[Gupin/Legends|gupins]] and [[Choreamnos|tree goats]]. They escaped and established populations on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].
